correctness.rationale: For square invertible unit-row A, gamma(pi)=lambda_min(A^T diag(pi) A) and positive gamma equivalent to diagonal majorant diag(d)>=C=(AA^T)^(-1) under congruence. Dual PSD correlation matrices with all diagonals1 have maximum tr C+2[wq(p-2+2z)-v(2z^2-1)], z=min(1,wq/(2v)), by triangle inequality and strict concavity. Explicit diagonal entries are d_s=d_t=C_ii+wq z-v(2z²-1), d_otherU=C_ii+wq, d_V=C_ii+w(p-2+2z); the quadratic forms in the proof decompose into SOS for v<=wq/2 and v>=wq/2, respectively, and satisfy SX=0, giving primal/dual equality and optimality. For any other optimal diagonal majorant D', complementarity S'X=0 and X_ii=1 force every d_i unique. Independently constructed sample positive definite C, exact certificate complementarity and minimum eigenvalues across 4 contrasting p,q,v settings; checked sharp gamma=1/T, including boundary. The theorem concerns feasible normalized-row systems, not every arbitrary C diagonal.
